title: Fix backend post createdAt timestamps and migrate existing “Backroads Litter” date

requirements.text: Update backend post creation so `createdAt` is stored as the current Unix epoch timestamp in seconds (Nat64) instead of `0` when the owner creates a new post.

quotes: the date is still not todays date. how would you fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Creating a new post as the admin stores `createdAt` as a non-zero value representing the current time in epoch seconds.
A newly created post appears in the UI with today’s date when formatted in Australia/Sydney timezone (using the existing frontend formatter).

requirements.text: Add a safe canister upgrade migration that permanently corrects invalid `createdAt` values in persisted posts, including ensuring the existing post titled "Backroads Litter" has a stored `createdAt` that renders as "08 January 2026" in the Australia/Sydney timezone.

quotes: the date is still not todays date. how would you fix it

acceptanceCriteria: The project includes an upgrade-safe migration path (per the platform’s conditional migration policy) so existing canister state can be upgraded without trapping.
After upgrade, any post(s) with invalid `createdAt` values (e.g., `0` / epoch-like) are updated to a reasonable non-zero epoch-seconds timestamp.
After upgrade, the post titled "Backroads Litter" renders as "08 January 2026" in Australia/Sydney timezone on both the home feed and post detail page (using existing frontend date formatting).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; do not introduce additional backend services.
Use a conditional upgrade migration approach; only add/modify migration code when upgrading existing state is required.
Keep all user-facing text in English.

Do not modify any frontend files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or any files in `frontend/src/components/ui`.
nonGoals: Integrate payments or any external entitlement/payment provider.
Change frontend date formatting rules (timezone/locale) beyond what already exists.
Add new UI features unrelated to correcting/normalizing stored `createdAt` timestamps.
